commands.note: Full suite passed before the final custom-catalog compatibility guard and removal of decorative industrial blueprint additions.
Final source compatibility retest: 31 tests passed. Includes custom kind 35 extraction, default save upgrades, finite production, factory premises, construction, demolition and serialization.
Playtest: actual native game UI and paid CitySimulation production in a fresh synthetic profile.

playtest.fixture: Fresh synthetic city; prebuilt factories, trained crews, seeded recipe inputs, private company funds, 60-second production rate at fixed workday hour. Crews are pinned at work sites to isolate production. This does not claim an unseeded city reached all eight eras.

steps.step: Click Businesses then Resource progression in the native Mayor dashboard; place roads and an industrial zone through game commands.
steps.expected: Settlement view, locked future eras and valid industrial zone.

steps.step: Attempt production work for the locked advanced company.
steps.observed: Stocks and company cash unchanged; locked status reported.

steps.step: Run paid simulation shifts until each era prerequisite is made.
steps.expected: Every era unlocks from completed batches; wages are paid.
steps.observed: All eight eras unlocked; multiple eras can unlock in one advance when their chains are ready.

steps.step: Run all advanced lines with equipment and inputs.
steps.expected: Plastics, electronics, alloys, modern trains and advanced vehicles made; electricity consumed.
steps.observed: Every advanced recipe has completed batches; owned electricity decreased. Progress and paid manufacturing screenshots captured.

steps.step: Reserve and finish dense housing, then demolish it.
steps.expected: Exact materials consumed, capacity eight and no roof left after demolition.
steps.observed: Finished eight-resident house; roof at y=36 cleared to air.

steps.step: Isolate an owned coal freight train and station; haul 16 units across 300 cells; try 900 cells.
steps.expected: Coal used for the first delivery; second delivery rejected.
steps.observed: Delivery passed and coal decreased; out-of-range delivery rejected.

steps.step: Save, read and restore the tested city.
steps.expected: Exact frame and tier-eight proofs retained.
steps.observed: Exact frame equality passed; restored era remains eight.

playtest.browser: Browser playtesting does not apply to this native Java/OpenGL game and its production CLI integration.

limitations: Transport is modeled as private freight and commuter services; this change has no separate rail route editor or vehicle models.
Starter masonry, basic glass and lighting recipes remain for bootstrap and saved-world compatibility.
Earlier full attempts hit time limits or were interrupted during fixes; no pass is claimed for those attempts.
